title: 第7章 霸王花铁海棠第8章 冷血一剑
slug: 惊天剑帝第7906章空气太敏感
content_zh:
林白刚刚离开洞府，便听见林中传来一阵打斗声音。
“有人对决吗？”林白悄悄咪咪的走了过去，躲在林中。
林中，一群五大三粗的男人追着一个面色带冷的女子。
这个女子皮肤略微有些黝黑，浑身干练，身穿短裙短袖，露出大腿与胳膊，双目灵动宛如一只狐狸。
这女子虽然没有贤淑典雅之气，反而却有一种野性之美。
“铁海棠，你今天是逃不出本公子的手掌心的！”背后那群追逐女子的男子中，有一个满脸阴冷邪笑的男子，冷声叫了一句。
前面的女子，名叫铁海棠，是斩妖盟的盟主之女，自幼好武，性子刚烈，修为高深，在青灵山脉素有“霸王花”之称。
“秦响，你别得意，等老娘剔除体内的毒素，非得将你下面的鸟蛋捏爆不可！”铁海棠在前方愤怒无比的说道。
秦响，擎天盟盟主之子，好色如命，仗着修为高深，是一个用毒的高手，自己的势力又是这个青灵山脉的土皇帝，可谓是飞扬跋扈，无恶不作。
曾经有很多城池的小姐到青灵山脉历练，都惨遭他的毒手！
之前在林中，秦响和铁海棠突然相遇，斩妖盟和擎天盟早已经是青灵山脉中的死对头，外加上秦响早就想碰碰铁海棠这朵霸王花了，故而二人一见面，便发生了一场恶战。
秦响用毒将斩妖盟的武者全部击杀之后，铁海棠也被暗算，无奈逃走。
秦响冷笑道：“哼哼，铁海棠，你知道本公子为什么要追着你跑这么久吗？难道你就没有感觉到你体内的真气和气血的流动，已经不是那么顺畅了吗？”
秦响一声冷笑，万分得意的说到。
“难道……，”铁海棠一惊，急忙查探体内的动静，随后便万分愤怒的惊喝道：“秦响你这么卑鄙小人，居然对我用‘合欢散’。”
“哈哈哈，现在才发现吗？已经晚了，再过一分钟，你就无法在调动真气，浑身酥软，那时候还不是本公子为所欲为的时候。”
秦响不慌不忙的追在铁海棠的身后，一脸春风得意。
“卑鄙！”
铁海棠心中万分的焦急。
合欢散，是一种失传已久的烈药，可以口服，也可以随风飘散，无色无味，而服下合欢散的武者，一刻钟之内就会禁锢真气，浑身酥软无力。

这种药，常年是被一些居心叵测之辈，用在奸。污女子武者身上的。
“糟糕，药性来了！”铁海棠往前跑出三步，便感觉身子一软，向地面上扑倒下去。
合欢散的药性，就好像是一只猛虎，瞬间就将铁海棠的柔弱的身躯给吞噬了！
铁海棠倒在地上，浑身无力，无法站起来，只能看着秦响带着一脸小人得志的笑容走了过来。
“怎么样？我说你今天逃不出本公子的手掌心吧。”秦响得意洋洋的说道。
铁海棠愤怒着：“秦响，我就算是死，也不会让你碰我的身子的！”
说完，铁海棠就要咬舌自尽。
“诶——，现在的你，连死的资格都没有。”秦响一把抓住了铁海棠的脸颊，钳住了她的上下齿，让她无法咬舌自尽，随后轻巧熟练的望铁海棠的嘴里塞入了布巾。
“哈哈哈，美人，接下来我看我表演了。”秦响一脸兴奋的对铁海棠说道。
转身一看，背后擎天盟的武者还在，秦响便怒吼一声：“你们还在这里干什么？还不快滚！”
“是，少盟主！”
这些擎天盟的武者，自然不可能耽误秦响寻欢作乐，应了一声，目光在铁海棠的身上贪婪的留恋了一分后，转身便离开了。
“小美人，我来了。”
秦响飞快的将自己的上衣脱掉，色眯眯的搓了搓手，一脸淫色的将手往铁海棠饱满圆润的双胸上伸了过去。
铁海棠看见这一幕，眼神似要吃人，但奈何她真气无法调动，浑身又没有力气，只能让秦响为所欲为！
content_en:
As soon as Lin Bai left the cave, he heard the sound of fighting in the forest.
"Is there anyone dueling?" Lin Bai quietly walked over and hid in the forest.
In the forest, a group of tall and thick men were chasing a cold-looking woman.
This woman's skin was slightly dark, and she was very capable. She was wearing a short skirt and short sleeves, exposing her thighs and arms, and her eyes were as lively as a fox's.
Although this woman is not virtuous and elegant, she has a wild beauty.
"Tie Haitang, you can't escape the clutches of my master today!" Among the group of men chasing the woman behind, a man with a sinister smile on his face shouted coldly.
The woman in front is named Tie Haitang. She is the daughter of the leader of the Demon Slayer Alliance. She has been fond of martial arts since she was a child, has a strong temperament, and has advanced cultivation. She is known as the "Overlord Flower" in the Qingling Mountains.
"Qin Xiang, don't be proud. When I get rid of the toxins in my body, I will crush the eggs underneath you!" Tie Haitang said angrily from the front.
Qin Xiang, the son of the leader of the Qingtian Alliance, is as lustful as life. He is a master of poisoning due to his advanced cultivation. He is also the local emperor of the Qingling Mountains. He is domineering and does all kinds of evil.
Many young ladies from the city once went to the Qingling Mountains for training, but they all suffered at his vicious hands!
In the forest, Qin Xiang and Tie Haitang suddenly met. The Demon Slaying Alliance and the Qingtian Alliance were already sworn enemies in the Qingling Mountains. In addition, Qin Xiang had long wanted to touch Tie Haitang, the overlord flower, so a fierce battle broke out as soon as the two met.
After Qin Xiang killed all the warriors of the Demon Slayer Alliance with poison, Tie Haitang was also plotted against and had no choice but to escape.
Qin Xiang sneered: "Humph, Tie Haitang, do you know why I have been chasing you for so long? Don't you feel that the flow of Qi and Qi and blood in your body is no longer so smooth?"
Qin Xiang sneered and said with great pride.
"Could it be...," Tie Haitang was startled and hurriedly checked what was going on in his body, and then shouted in great anger: "Qin Xiang, you are such a despicable person, you actually used 'Hehuan San' on me."
"Hahaha, did you realize it now? It's already too late. In another minute, you won't be able to mobilize your true energy and your whole body will be soft. That's not the time for me to do whatever I want."
Qin Xiang calmly chased after Tie Haitang, with a proud look on his face.
"Despicable!"
Tie Haitang was extremely anxious.
Hehuan Powder is a long-lost potent medicine that can be taken orally or dispersed in the wind. It is colorless and odorless. A warrior who takes Hehuan Powder will confine his true energy within a quarter of an hour, making his whole body soft and weak.
This kind of medicine has been used for rape by some people with ulterior motives all year round. Dirty female warriors.
"Oops, the medicine is here!" Tie Haitang ran forward three steps, then felt his body go weak and fell to the ground.
The medicinal properties of Hehuan Powder were like a fierce tiger that devoured Tie Haitang's weak body in an instant!
Tie Haitang fell to the ground, too weak to stand up. He could only watch Qin Xiang walking over with a triumphant smile on his face.
"How's it going? I said you can't escape from my master today, right?" Qin Xiang said proudly.
Tie Haitang was angry: "Qin Xiang, even if I die, I will not let you touch my body!"
After saying that, Tie Haitang was about to bite his tongue and commit suicide.
"Eh--, you are not even qualified to die now." Qin Xiang grabbed Tie Haitang's cheek and clamped her upper and lower teeth so that she could not bite her tongue to commit suicide. Then he dexterously and skillfully stuffed a cloth into Tie Haitang's mouth.
"Hahaha, beauty, let's see my performance next." Qin Xiang said to Tie Haitang with excitement.
When he turned around and saw that the warriors from the Qingtian Alliance were still there behind him, Qin Xiang roared: "What are you still doing here? Get out of here!"
"Yes, Young Leader!"
These warriors of the Qingtian Alliance, naturally it was impossible to delay Qin Xiang's pursuit of pleasure, so he responded, his eyes lingering greedily on Tie Haitang for a while, and then turned around and left.
"Little beauty, here I come."
Qin Xiang quickly took off his shirt, rubbed his hands lustfully, and stretched his hands towards Tie Haitang's plump and round breasts with a lustful look on his face.
When Tie Haitang saw this scene, her eyes seemed to want to eat people, but she couldn't mobilize her true energy and had no strength in her body, so she could only let Qin Xiang do whatever he wanted!
